A '''subsonic seed germinator''' was a piece of [[Farm/Legends|farming]] equipment. [[Otis]], owner of [[Otis' Livery]] in [[Southview Village]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]] was repairing one when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] members entered the business.
